def bands_of(g, out_h=None):
    """Split a vertically stacked grid into n equal-height horizontal bands; returns list of (dominant nonzero color, subgrid)."""
    if out_h is None:  # default: infer from test/output height if given elsewhere; caller passes out_h
        raise ValueError('out_h required')

        bs.append((col, seg))
    return bs

def priority_overlay(bs, out_h, prio, first_band_wins=True):
